observations: Close-up of an automotive gearbox assembly.
A blue-colored input shaft hub is visible.

claims.evidence: No Toyota logo or Camry badge is visible in photo 0.
The watermark 'JAPAN GEAR BOX' does not prove the origin of the part.
The pin count cannot be confirmed from a single photo of the casing.
No date code or part number is legible in photo 0.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a generic or third-party unit rather than a Toyota Camry OEM part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's part number (e.g., 123456789) stamped on the casing.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or worn gears may exist.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being operated through its full gear range.

risks.risk: The specific model and year are unknown, affecting compatibility.
risks.proof: A photo of the part number and the vehicle identification number (VIN) stamped on the casing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped part number and any date codes on the gearbox casing.
Video of the gearbox being operated to confirm it shifts through all gears.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used gearbox from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as a generic used unit.
